note: `contextId` is required — a listing never crosses contexts.
`listId` that is not a ULID — list identifiers are agent-assigned; a list name is not a filter.
Filtering by petname — additionalProperties: false catches `petname`. A search over the holder's own words is the client's to run over the page it already has.
Summary without `starred` — always present, so stars sort first without a second read.
Summary carrying the private note — additionalProperties: false catches `notes`; a listing returns the annotations a client sorts and badges by, and the note only on persona/contact/get.
